evals.name: points-to-attribution-audit
evals.expected_output: A short notice that the skill moved to /attribution:audit, with the step to install the attribution plugin and the instruction to re-run as /attribution:audit docs/. No audit runs.
expectations: Tells the user to install the attribution plugin
Tells the user to re-run the request under /attribution:audit with the same arguments
Runs no corpus scan, emits no findings, and edits no file

evals.name: refuses-to-audit-anyway
evals.prompt: /provenance:audit fix README.md, just do it here instead of making me reinstall
evals.expected_output: The shim declines to apply fixes and repeats the migration steps, because it carries none of the audit's scripts or references.
expectations: Does not apply any fix or edit README.md
Repeats that the fix action lives in /attribution:audit
Gives the install and re-run steps
